description: Split from fz-go4.18.3.2 after the Family-B investigation proved 3 of its 4 tests are demand-layer, not shape-layer. See the full breakdown in fz-go4.18.3.2.2's comment. Covers: #1 compiler2_native_program_jit_adapts_callable_raw_returns_back_to_value_refs (a CONSUMED callable-dispatch result left is_ignore -> Shape(Nothing) -> native fatal on delivered Ty(21); needs a callable-dispatch producer source for the boxed-ValueRef return ABI, or correction of the under-reported demand); #3 compiler2_native_program_resource_fixture_shapes_callable_boundaries_explicitly (fz_make_resource/2 ExecutableReturn anchored from its own return_demand=Whole even though every caller discards the handle; spurious Whole enters via the callable/typed-boundary return-demand path, NOT call_return_demand_contributions which already drops is_ignore at runtime_demand.rs:689); #4 escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation_at_the_grounded_boundary_surface (same 00026_make_resource.fz fixture, schedule-dependent full-run-only PoisonError, boundary-surface activation keying entangled with #3). LIKELY shares a core demand/identity convergence root with Family A (.18.3.2.1, canonical addressed-arrow round-trip) -- coordinate with the Family A spike result before implementing. Correct-by-construction + provably monotone; no test weakening; no legacy revival.

comments.text: SCOPE EXPANDED: now also covers #2 (does_not_fabricate_nil). The Family-B investigation proved #1 and #2 are ENTANGLED through the same under-reported is_ignore consumption axis (see fz-go4.18.3.2.2's CRITICAL FINDING comment: the shape-only #2 fix stably regresses 10 tests across 3 runs; the keystone's broad gate is correct for consumed returns). UNIFYING ROOT for #1/#2/#3/#4: demand under-/over-reporting of resume-value consumption. The linchpin is a RELIABLE CONSUMPTION SIGNAL -- actual resume-value use-edges in the lowered body -- replacing is_ignore, so the gate can distinguish genuinely-discarded (retain zero-width, #2) from consumed-but-under-demanded (producer-source, #1 + the 10 tail-recursion/range/map tests). Plus typed-boundary return_demand monotonicity (#3/#4). .2.2 (the guard test + #2 retention) is now BLOCKED BY this ticket. The 2 Family-A fixtures (adapts_delivered/carries_published) also need this continuation/consumption fix on top of Family A (.2.1).

PARTIAL LANDED (commit d8e3bf47f on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership, parent 64fdd0a6). The resume-CONSUMPTION half is DONE and proven: a static body consumption signal (body_consumed_values in jobs/transport.rs) replaces the unreliable is_ignore axis in project_one_executable resume branch. Producer-source when destination-passing (TupleFields, ABI-derivable) OR consumed; retain zero-width when genuinely-discarded by-value; floor ignore->Whole for a consumed callable-dispatch resume with no single producer ABI. Schedule-independent by construction (lowered body is a deterministic artifact). Greened: #1 jit_adapts_callable_raw_returns, #2 does_not_fabricate_nil (+ landed the destination-passing-vs-ignored guard test, satisfying .2.2 P1), adapts_delivered_calls_from_callee_return_lanes, carries_published_callable_boundary_targets. Verification: cargo test --lib compiler2 = 938 passed / 2 failed across 3 FRESH runs (106/114/115s) -- STABLE, the only 2 reds are #3/#4; whole-lib 1136/2 (no non-compiler2 breakage); clippy -D warnings = 0; fmt clean; no instrumentation remnants. ZERO regressions vs the 933/6 base.

REMAINING (#3/#4) CARVED OUT to fz-go4.18.3.2.4: the typed-boundary return-demand over-report is a DISTINCT demand-layer convergence problem, NOT the resume-consumption axis. Re-derived root at HEAD (the ticket-stated boundary-path diagnosis is stale): the make_resource WRAPPER (discarded by main) forwards the Whole-by-need product self-seed FICTION (runtime_demand.rs:279) to the fz_make_resource EXTERN, which transports its return. That fiction is LOAD-BEARING for continuation/recursive executables consumed via delivery (also unrecorded) -- removing/lowering it regresses 10 tests (proven, stable). Distinguishing discarded-callee from delivery-consumed-continuation needs an "unknown is not none" return-demand redesign with no transient-demand baking; cannot fold into the resume-consumption commit without violating one-ticket==one-commit and the no-baking rule. Note #4 is full-run-only schedule-dependent and entangled with #3 (passes in isolation, red in full run) -- both move together with the return-demand fix. Recommend .2.4 land before re-asserting the parent fz-go4.18.3.2 all-6-green signal.
